_contract: The THREE-SHAPE pricing of the step-1/step-2 split. Superseded when A3 became one end-to-end experiment: one chain has one price, and keeping a second pricer beside it is the complexity ratchet AGENTS.md P8.2.1 forbids. Its producer, scripts/experiments/phase_c3/a_bsz3_pricing.py, was deleted rather than left importable.

what_it_priced.step1_structural: expected $0.7328, hard $1.5815, booked to the GPU engineering allowance

why_it_was_superseded: the split it priced no longer exists. A3 runs initialization, recovery, evaluation, aggregation and closeout in ONE session, so there is one ceiling to authorize rather than two and the engineering-allowance booking of a first half does not apply: the single session trains probes and consumes the frozen confirmation battery, which the package places on the formal book.
what_the_successor_changed: aggregation and evidence collection priced inside the chain
container disk DERIVED -- 60 GB from a 36.06 GiB peak local residency -- instead of C3's 120 GB carried forward
the durable requirement stated separately: 6.664 GiB for three probes, bounded against the backend rather than against container storage
EVERY applicable limit checked, including the package total, through formal_pricing.evaluate_limits
_the_numbers_are_close_and_that_is_a_coi: the superseded worst case across both steps was $9.7348 and the funded A3 figure is $9.7031. They are not the same quantity: the first was two sessions' ceilings summed, the second is one session's ceiling plus one pre-science restart.
